WITH counted_trades AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as trade_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals_cte AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(trade_count) as total_count,
    AVG(trade_count) as avg_count
  FROM counted_trades
),
trades_with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.tradekind,
    ct.trade_count,
    ct.trade_count::float / tc.total_count as share,
    ct.trade_count - tc.avg_count as above_avg,
    tc.avg_count as type_average
  FROM counted_trades ct
  CROSS JOIN totals_cte tc
),
above_average_trades AS (
  SELECT * 
  FROM trades_with_metrics
  WHERE trade_count > type_average
)
SELECT 
  SUM(trade_count) as combined_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(above_avg) as average_above_avg
FROM above_average_trades

assumptions.assumption: An 'analysed trade record' is a unique transactionrecord with an associated advancedbehavior record. If multiple advancedbehavior records reference the same transactionrecord, the trade is counted once.

alternatives.interpretation: Count advancedbehavior records instead of unique transactionrecords, interpreting 'analysed trade records' as the count of analysis records rather than the count of unique trades analysed.
